Each feature flag remains independently optional in the type and has raw true | false | undefined semantics; no declaration normalizes absence. Make AIAssistantEventName the single source of all six outbound summary strings, and require adapter aliases and transport discriminants to derive from its member value types. Keep the existing CC_TASK_EVENTS.POST_CALL_SUMMARY and MID_CALL_SUMMARY literals as the single value sources for those shared wire names; define the corresponding CC_AI_SUMMARY_EVENTS members from the CC_TASK_EVENTS properties rather than duplicate literals, add literals only for FEATURE_ENABLEMENT and MID_CALL_SUMMARY_RESPONSE_SUBSEQUENT_AGENT, and spread CC_EVENTS in the exact order CC_AGENT_EVENTS, CC_TASK_EVENTS, then CC_AI_SUMMARY_EVENTS. The two CC_TASK_EVENTS members remain deprecated only as emitted-event names and are proven never emitted. Declare the six-value AI_SUMMARY_ERROR_CODES object in src/constants.ts and re-export it from src/index.ts for stable Error.message/data.errorCode matching; also declare package-internal AI_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_TYPE = 'WxCC' as const. Explicitly export the public payloads/constants from src/index.ts while omitting AISummaryInboundType, AISummaryPayloadByInboundType, AISummaryTimeoutCodeByInboundType, AISummaryPendingRegistration, AISummaryRequestCoordinator, GeneratedSummaryFlagsAccessor, AISummaryResponseTransportPayload, SummaryResponseTimestamps, AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED, and AI_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_TYPE from that barrel. In src/services/task/constants.ts, export package-internal AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS = 30_000 once and export AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS = AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, and AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS = AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS; also export package-internal AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED = 'AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED' as const; production and fake-timer test call sites import the applicable semantic alias and never inline the duration. Declare the exact MID_CALL_SUMMARY_RESPONSE_SUBSEQUENT_AGENT receiver event and add every approved public type, constant, event, metric, method signature, and barrel export without removing or renaming an existing symbol. Extend services/config/index.ts tests to assert both shared-member identities, the two new raw discriminator literals, and CC_EVENTS membership under the normative spread order. Emit the four required ITask members and public response timestamp fields through the existing dist/types/index.d.ts path; use Pick/Partial for behavior-focused test doubles rather than complete structural implementations. tasks.title: Add exact AI Assistant summary transport
tasks.description: REQ-010, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033, REQ-034, REQ-035, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, DR-1, DR-3, REQ-042, REQ-043, REQ-056, PR-1, PR-2, PR-3, AC-1, AC-4, and AC-10 / Component: AI Assistant transport and outbound serialization - use the exact exported class symbol ApiAIAssistant from the exact case-sensitive module path packages/@webex/contact-center/src/services/ApiAiAssistant.ts (the filename casing does not rename the live symbol); add ApiAIAssistant.sendSummaryGetEvent and sendSummaryResponseEvent, with package-internal SummaryGetEventName and SummaryResponseEventName aliases in ApiAiAssistant.ts derived from the six AIAssistantEventName member value types rather than repeated string literals, reusing getBaseUrl, credentials, /event, POST, auth, getErrorDetails, core TIMEOUT_REQ, and package-internal AI_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_TYPE. In ApiAiAssistant.ts, declare package-internal source-module exports AI_SUMMARY_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS = TIMEOUT_REQ and AI_SUMMARY_TRANSPORT_ERROR_CODES with exact VALIDATION_FAILED = AI_SUMMARY_TRANSPORT_VALIDATION_FAILED, HTTP_REQUEST_FAILED = AI_SUMMARY_HTTP_REQUEST_FAILED, and TIMEOUT = AI_SUMMARY_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT values; omit both from the package root. Add one private buildSummaryEventEnvelope helper with a discriminated GET/response input; both public methods must call it, it alone constructs every HTTP body level field-by-field with no caller-object or partial-object spread, it writes the shared agentId/orgId/eventType/eventName/publishTimestamp/eventDetails.data identifier/clientType/actionTimeStamp envelope, and its response branch selects only the allowed flow fields. Reject a missing/unknown base URL with root-exported AI_SUMMARY_ERROR_CODES.AI_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL_NOT_AVAILABLE in both Error.message and data.errorCode. Inside both async methods, reject rather than synchronously throw with exact transport VALIDATION_FAILED message/data.errorCode for empty agentId, derived orgId, interactionId, or conversationId, an event name outside that method's three-member union, or invalid response timestamps; perform this validation before base-URL resolution, body construction, timers, and webex.request. Serialize independently derived conversationId and interactionId without collapsing them. For GET requests, capture one Date.now() value for both timestamps. For responses, preserve independently supplied finite non-negative actionTimeStamp and publishTimestamp values, capture one fallback Date.now() per call, and use it only for omitted fields. Omit the SDK-only summaryReceived discriminator; a mid-call body must have no wrapUpCode key and a post-call body no agentName key, including no undefined-valued key. Add one private bounded-post helper used by both methods: make one webex.request attempt with timeout: AI_SUMMARY_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS, race it with one same-duration guard so an injected never-settling Promise still settles, attach the late rejection handler immediately, clear the guard in finally, return void on success, normalize the guard or exact ETIMEDOUT result to transport TIMEOUT, and never retry. For every other HTTP rejection, read only an optional finite numeric top-level statusCode, discard the original error, create a fresh projection from the bounded request-failure code, method/event, and safe identifiers, and pass only that projection to getErrorDetails or diagnostics; never forward or stringify the original message, stack, request, options, body, response, details, or cause. Extend the existing case-sensitive ApiAiAssistant Jest target with complete toStrictEqual request-object tests for all six names through the shared builder, not.toHaveProperty assertions for every flow-invalid key, request clock reuse, distinct supplied response timestamps, one-field/two-field fallback, post-call/consult/transfer/cancel happy paths, Promise-only table-driven validation rejection with no HTTP for every empty identifier and both out-of-union event directions, one HTTP attempt carrying the timeout, fake-timer TIMEOUT rejection and zero stale guards for never-resolving GET and response paths, and a privacy case whose rejected error carries the serialized body through message/request/options/response/cause while the returned error and every logger/metric spy remain sentinel-free. The focused adapter suite is acceptance evidence only for the outbound-serialization portion of AC-1, the cancellation-serialization portion of AC-4, and the adapter privacy boundary of AC-10; AC-2/AC-3 typed settlement remains with realtime coordination, and executable response-before-handoff assertions remain in Task's repository-native Jest target; documentation mirrors but does not verify them. This task is the REQ-056 sanitized HTTP-failure and bounded-transport implementation owner and depends on define-ai-summary-contracts for exact discriminants, transport types, public/internal export boundaries, and the client-type constant.

tasks.title: Coordinate pending requests and receiving-agent delivery
tasks.description: G-3, G-4, REQ-006, REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-012, REQ-028, REQ-029, REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-039, FR-1, FR-2, FR-4, FR-8, FR-9, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, DR-5, REQ-044, REQ-045, REQ-046, REQ-047, REQ-048, REQ-056, PR-1, PR-2, PR-3, AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-5, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, and AC-11 / Component: Realtime coordination, correlation, and receiver delivery - add tryGetAISummaryCorrelation with the exact {conversationId, interactionId} return shape (conversationId = mainInteractionId ?? interactionId; interactionId = the task's top-level interactionId) or undefined for an empty identifier, and implement getAISummaryCorrelation as the throwing wrapper that throws AI_SUMMARY_CORRELATION_NOT_AVAILABLE only for Task outbound API validation. TaskManager must use the non-throwing helper for every AI-summary registry scan and lifecycle derivation, skip an invalid task with the bounded {reason: 'invalid-task-correlation', scanContext, taskId} metadata-only warning, and continue the RTD/lifecycle callback. Add a package-internal AISummaryCoordinator implementing the narrow request-coordinator interface. TaskManager lifecycle-owns one coordinator and the FR-11 request, FR-8 receiver-buffer, and orphan-feature timer/lifecycle policies, while AISummaryCoordinator directly owns the event-type-indexed pendingAISummaryRequests registry, receivingSummaryBuffer, interactionFeatureEnablement, and all timer handles. Arm the request timer only with accepted pending insertion, the receiver timer only with buffer insertion/replacement, and the feature timer only for a snapshot whose canonical interaction key has no registered task; use removeTimedEntry so pending terminal paths clear the timer, settle the resolver/rejector while its key remains occupied, and delete the key before Promise reactions, while receiver/feature paths clear and delete before replacement, promotion, delivery, expiry, task cleanup, or unscoped full-session cleanup. Use AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS for pending requests, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS for receiver buffers, and AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS for orphan feature snapshots, with all three exported source-module aliases backed by the single AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS value and package-internal AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED defining cancellation settlement; preserve exact validated event-type correlation, timeout/overlap/late-event outcomes, latest-only buffering, ambiguity protection, and scoped/full cleanup. For a valid subsequent-agent payload with zero or multiple matching registered tasks, routeReceivingSummary replaces the per-conversation buffer with the latest payload and arms/rearms AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS. After TaskManager inserts or updates a task, it calls retainFeatureEnablementForTask with the canonical interaction key before emitting its incoming/hydrate lifecycle event; after that event its private flushReceivingSummaryForTask helper recomputes the complete current conversation candidate set before calling flushReceivingSummary, where exactly one candidate makes the coordinator clear the buffer/timer before one delivery and zero or multiple candidates retain it. The same helper runs after individual task removal/deregistration and registry deletion, so ambiguity disappearing from two matches to one delivers before timeout; zero or multiple remaining matches retain the original buffer/timer. Individual removal never blindly deletes receiver state. Delivery, replacement, expiry, and unscoped full-session cleanup remove receiver state through the same private removeTimedEntry helper; a new-registration/connection-re-establishment reset or full SDK deregistration clears rather than re-flushes. Use payload.interactionId as the feature map key only when it exactly equals the top-level TaskData.interactionId produced as get/tryGetAISummaryCorrelation(...).interactionId. This remains the task child's own top-level identifier when mainInteractionId supplies a different conversation key. TaskManager writer presence checks, task-registration promotion, and final-task cleanup use tryGetAISummaryCorrelation, while Task request gating uses getAISummaryCorrelation; neither path substitutes conversationId/mainInteractionId. A frame keyed by that differing conversation value creates no enabled snapshot for the task and gating remains disabled, with no fallback. Validate postCallEnabled and midCallEnabled independently as absent or boolean, pass the original valid payload to AISummaryCoordinator, and store each flag as raw true | false | undefined without coercion; request gating permits only the selected flag === true. Store an unmatched feature snapshot with AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS, remove that timer when a matching task registers, retain active state only for the matching task lifecycle, and clear every form during full cleanup. TaskManager remains the raw double-envelope parser and task-registry owner, holds the current profile-derived ConfigFlags view, exposes the bound getGeneratedSummaryFlags accessor injected into every Task, composes exactly one coordinator for its own lifetime, derives complete conversation-matching task candidate sets from defined tryGetAISummaryCorrelation results only, and delegates only validated payloads/state transitions while preserving transcript and suggested-response routing. Represent the logical pending key of conversationId plus inbound summary type as a conversation-keyed map per event type because FR-9 exposes no task/request identifier; make each entry generic in its event type so its resolver accepts exactly AISummaryPayloadByInboundType[T] and the paired async registration returns AISummaryPendingRegistration<T>, whose result is that exact Promise payload without a Task assertion. Implement registerPendingAISummaryRequest as an async method with no internal await: atomically check the key, reject its registration Promise with augmented AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_ALREADY_PENDING before constructing an inbound-result Promise, insertion, or timer arm when occupied, otherwise insert and resolve with the result-Promise handle; Task awaits acceptance before HTTP, so overlap cannot start HTTP. Require taskId on registration and cancellation as the ownership guard, so cancellation and per-task cleanup are no-ops for a sibling owner's entry. Define cancelPendingAISummaryRequest as the named HTTP-failure path: on an owner match it clears the timer, rejects registration.result with exact package-internal AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED while the key remains occupied, and deletes the key through removeTimedEntry before returning; Task has already attached that result Promise to Promise.all, so the secondary cancellation rejection is handled even when HTTP settled the aggregate first. Treat CONSULT and TRANSFER as one MID_CALL_SUMMARY slot despite their distinct outbound names. Classify FEATURE_ENABLEMENT before inner-payload validation, then emit exactly one receive metric after validation supplies the valid/invalid outcome for every classified frame, including repeated and payload-invalid frames; forward/store only valid payloads and exclude unparseable or unclassifiable frames from that metric. A valid-frame metric records both exact tags postCallEnabled and midCallEnabled, using the validated boolean when present and the bounded string 'absent' when missing, never undefined; an invalid-frame metric includes only a bounded validation code and no unvalidated flag. For every valid FEATURE_ENABLEMENT payload, TaskManager's raw RTD parser calls AISummaryCoordinator.setFeatureEnablement(payload, hasRegisteredTask) before emitting AGENT_EVENTS.FEATURE_ENABLEMENT through TaskManager's EventEmitter without importing ContactCenter; Task request gating reads the latest raw snapshot through the injected coordinator's getFeatureEnablement accessor using the same canonical top-level interaction key. Implement the complete coordinator surface from the design inventory: getFeatureEnablement, async registerPendingAISummaryRequest, cancelPendingAISummaryRequest, setFeatureEnablement, retainFeatureEnablementForTask, clearFeatureEnablement, resolvePendingAISummaryRequest, routeReceivingSummary, flushReceivingSummary, clearTaskAISummaryState, and clearAISummaryState. TaskManager.clearAISummaryState first marks AI-summary inbound handling inactive and then invokes coordinator cleanup, which clears each associated request timer, rejects its still-pending post-call or mid-call result Promise with exact AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED while the key remains occupied, deletes that key before Promise reactions, and clears receiver buffers, feature snapshots, and their timers. Any classified AI-summary frame received while inactive is dropped exactly once with bounded sdk-deregistered metadata and cannot resolve, buffer, mutate, emit, or recreate a timer; the next registration profile refresh through setConfigFlags reactivates handling. Emit AI_SUMMARY_INBOUND_EVENT_DROPPED exactly once with a bounded reason for each malformed, unknown, late, or uncorrelated summary frame, without double-counting classified invalid feature frames. For malformed, late, uncorrelated, and buffered receiver input, log or metric only bounded event/outcome metadata and never summary text, section values, Adaptive Card bodies, raw envelopes, or arbitrary exception text. Add direct AISummaryCoordinator fake-timer and typed-contract tests that import AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, AI_SUMMARY_RECEIVER_BUFFER_RETENTION_MS, and AI_SUMMARY_FEATURE_ORPHAN_RETENTION_MS, prove each equals AI_SUMMARY_DURATION_MS, and cover exact post-call/mid-call payload inference without assertions, the exact request/buffer/orphan-feature arm points, resolver, named owner cancellation clear/settle-while-keyed/delete settlement with exact AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED and an attached handler, Promise-only overlap rejection from awaited registration with no new result Promise or timer, first-entry retention through resolver/rejector settlement, deletion before Promise reactions, immediate sequential registration after every terminal outcome, owner cleanup, canonical feature-key writer/reader/registration/cleanup parity including a child task whose mainInteractionId differs and is never used as fallback, raw true/false/undefined flag retention, orphan replacement/expiry and task promotion, buffer-on-miss, replacement, registration-triggered flush/delivery, removal-triggered uniqueness re-flush/delivery-or-retention, expiry, scoped/full cleanup, ambiguity, privacy, shared-duration boundaries, exact exported timeout/overlap codes, and no stale timers on every cleanup path; keep TaskManager tests focused on parsing, validation, delegation, candidate selection, a registered task with an empty interactionId that is skipped without throwing while a sole valid peer still receives or a no-valid-candidate frame buffers, flush after task registration/listener availability and after post-registry-delete task removal, feature enablement raw-tri-state store/read, boolean-or-'absent' valid metric tags, differing-event latest replacement, identical-event non-deduplicated delegation/emission, top-level-interaction-only lookup with no conversation-key fallback, final-task eviction, clearAISummaryState rejection of simultaneous post-call and mid-call pending Promises with exact AI_SUMMARY_REQUEST_CANCELLED plus full request/buffer/feature/timer eviction, one post-clear frame per summary discriminator producing only a bounded sdk-deregistered drop with no new state or event, setConfigFlags reactivation for the next registration, proof that legacy initiator aliases are never emitted, metrics, lifecycle integration, and regressions; make TaskUtils tests prove tryGetAISummaryCorrelation returns undefined without throwing for empty identifiers while getAISummaryCorrelation throws the exact named error. This task owns the realtime slices of REQ-010, REQ-056, and PR-3: timeout, unknown-task, malformed/uncorrelated/late-event isolation, scoped/full cleanup, and the named AC state/RTD assertions; it does not claim public Task selection, adapter serialization, or consumer sequencing. It depends only on contract types so it can proceed independently of HTTP transport.

tasks.description: G-1, G-2, G-4, G-5, REQ-005, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4, FR-5, FR-6, FR-7, FR-10, FR-11, FR-12, DR-1, DR-2, DR-3, DR-4, REQ-040, REQ-041, REQ-042, REQ-043, REQ-044, REQ-045, REQ-049, REQ-050, REQ-056, PR-1, PR-2, AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-10, and AC-11 / Component: Public contracts and task API plus Change: Consumer sequencing and response semantics - implement Task.configureAISummary, requestPostCallSummary, sendPostCallSummaryResponse, requestMidCallSummary, and sendMidCallSummaryResponse as additive inherited Task methods; validate structured-or-text/empty shapes using the required mid-call summaryReceived: true | false discriminant, finite non-negative counters, optional finite non-negative actionTimeStamp/publishTimestamp fields, closed action/state/feedback vocabularies, non-empty post-call wrapUpCode, and non-empty mid-call agentName; derive distinct conversationId and top-level interactionId through getAISummaryCorrelation.
